items.t: ADM to Present at Goldman Sachs Industrials & Materials Conference 2026
items.sum: CHICAGO, November 18, 2026--ADM (NYSE: ADM) will present at the Goldman Sachs Industrials & Materials Conference 2026 on Wednesday, Dec. 2, in New York City. The company will participate in a fireside chat at 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time.

items.t: ADM Raises 2026 Earnings Outlook as Biofuel Strength Lifts Profit
items.sum: ADM raises its 2026 earnings outlook as strong ethanol and biodiesel margins boost profits, with biofuel momentum supporting growth expectations into 2027.

items.t: Is ADM Stock Worth Buying as Earnings Improve but Key Risks Persist?
items.sum: ADM's earnings rebound, raised 2026 outlook and cost-saving initiatives strengthen its value appeal, but commodity volatility and policy risks warrant caution.

items.t: ADM Stock Falls 11.8% in the Past Month: Is the Pullback a Buy Now?
items.sum: ADM's shares fall 11.8% in a month despite stronger Q3 earnings and raised 2026 guidance. Can biofuel strength and Nutrition recovery outweigh margin and policy risks?

items.t: ADM Announces More Than $60 Million in Investments at Decatur Oilseed Facility
items.sum: DECATUR, Ill., November 16, 2026--ADM (NYSE: ADM), a global leader in innovative solutions from nature, today announced five projects totaling more than $60 million across its Decatur West oilseeds facility, continuing ADM’s longstanding investment in its Decatur operations.

items.t: How to Maximize Your Retirement Portfolio with These Top-Ranked Dividend Stocks
items.sum: The traditional ways to plan for your retirement may mean income can no longer cover expenses post-employment. But what if there was another option that could provide a steady, reliable source of income in your nest egg years?
